description: Published answers to common questions about one product, optionally filtered by a question phrase, each with a link to the full answer on shopsavvy.com. Pass an identifier (barcode, ASIN, URL, name or ShopSavvy ID). Free without an API key; with a key, 1 credit per 5 answers returned (minimum 1). If nothing matches, say there is no published answer; do not make one up.

identifier.description: Product identifier (barcode, ASIN, URL, product name, or ShopSavvy ID)

question.description: Optional: specific question to search for
